transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I came in because my thinking just feels foggy. I’m having trouble keeping my place in my old cataloguing notes at work, and sometimes I can’t even decide what simple thing I’m supposed to do next. It’s been frustrating.
Have you been feeling down, sad, or hopeless most of the day, nearly every day, lately?

Yes… most days lately I do feel pretty down. I’ll sit at the kitchen table and it’s like the color has gone out of everything. Even my old watercolor books, which I used to enjoy, just make me feel heavy instead of interested.
Have you lost interest in activities you used to enjoy, like your watercolor books, or does it just feel harder to get into them now?

It’s more that I’ve lost interest, I think. I can pick up the watercolor books, but they don’t pull me in anymore. I just feel heavy looking at them, like everything’s kind of dull or drained of color.
Have you been feeling more tired or lacking energy lately, even if you haven’t done much physically?
I’m not really sure. I mean, I feel worn down, but I haven’t been paying close attention to whether it’s tiredness or just… not wanting to do much. I can’t say clearly.
Over the past two weeks, have you noticed a clear drop in your energy or felt unusually tired, even when you haven't been doing much?
I’m still not sure I can say it’s a clear drop in energy. I do feel kind of worn out and slowed down, but I haven’t really noticed whether I’m unusually tired compared to normal.
Have you noticed any difficulty thinking clearly, concentrating, or making decisions lately?

Yes. That’s actually part of why I came in. My mind feels foggy, and I have trouble keeping my place even in my old cataloguing notes. Sometimes I just sit there trying to decide what simple thing to do next, and it feels harder than it should.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight recently—like eating more or less than usual, or gaining or losing weight without trying?

Yes, I think so. I haven’t had much appetite. I have to remind myself to eat sometimes, and my wife has noticed I’m leaving rice and soup half-finished. I didn’t used to do that—I usually wouldn’t waste a meal.
Have you noticed any changes in your sleep lately, like having trouble falling asleep, waking up during the night, or waking up earlier than usual and not being able to go back to sleep?

Yes. I go to bed feeling tired, but then I wake up around four in the morning. After that I just lie there, thinking about what I’m supposed to do with myself now, and I can’t really get back to sleep.
